film.title: She's All That
S: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and salt to a coarse paste and roll into 16 balls. Fry in hot oil in batches until deep brown and crisp. Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, salt and water until pourable. Warm the pita, fill with falafel and tomato and drizzle with tahini.
2 x 400g tins chickpeas, drained and patted dry@Pantry

Warm the beans with the paprika, cumin, a splash of water and salt, crushing a few. Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt. Layer the chips, beans and cheddar on a tray and bake at 200C until the cheese melts. Top with salsa, guacamole, sour cream and jalapenos and serve straight away.
M: Mix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in a hot pan. Add the passata, oregano and the rest of the garlic and simmer until thick. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, top with provolone and grill until melted. Tuck in the basil and serve.
Laney says yes to the beach

Rub the fish with the spices, oil and salt. Toss the cabbage with the juice of 2 limes and salt, and stir the chipotle into the sour cream. Grill the fish until just flaking, then break into chunks. Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle cream, coriander and lime.
W: Red dress on the stairs strawberry shortcake

Toss the strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar and leave to go juicy. Rub the butter into the flour and 60g sugar, stir in the buttermilk and pat out 3cm thick. Cut 4 rounds and bake at 210C until golden. Whip the cream with the vanilla, split the shortcakes and fill with berries and cream.
60g caster sugar, plus 2 tbsp for the berries@Pantry
K: Stir the pineapple and cranberry juices together in a punch bowl. Add the lime slices, frozen raspberries and ice. Top with lemonade just before serving.
film.T: A new comedy that proves there's more to attraction than meets the eye.
film.D: A dumped high school king bets he can turn the school's quiet art student into prom queen in six weeks.
film.P: Serve the fish tacos when Laney goes to the beach with Zack.
